annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, and exact finite-gamma strengthening of the paper's first-order summation passage

assumptions: The summation model satisfies the standard relative-error rule for addition and exact addition to zero.
The exact gamma denominator for n-1 additions is positive.
All terms are nonnegative and their exact sum is nonzero.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P14 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P14 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p14_t1_positive_recursive_sum_relative_error (fp : StandardAddModel) (n : Nat) (w : Fin n -> Real) ... : |recursiveSum ... - sum w| / |sum w| <= gamma fp.u (n-1)
formal_statement.plain_language: Recursive summation of a nonnegative nonzero family has relative error at most gamma for n-1 rounded additions.

informal_proof: Use the exact backward-error representation for recursive summation, take absolute values, and use nonnegativity to identify the sum of magnitudes with the exact sum.
informal_statement: Exact finite-gamma form of the positive exponential-summation stage used to derive equation (3.3).
